name: Mito Securities Co., Ltd.
summary: Mito Securities Co., Ltd. provides investment and financial services in Japan. It offers fund wrap, investment trust, foreign and domestic bond, foreign and domestic stock, real estate investment trust, exchange traded fund, leveraged and inverse ETFs and ETNs, actively managed ETFs, and newly issued shares, as well as individual annuity insurance products. The company also provides multi-channel and net services; deposits, withdrawals, and transfers services; and stock price inquiry, electronic delivery, and automated voice response service. The company was founded in 1921 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.
